Name: Bikini Top Sprite Overhaul
Author: Pandaboff
Description:
[b]CHANGES
 - From version 1.0.1. [/b]The mod no longer overlaps the entire shirts file.
 [b]->[/b] manifest.json now has "UpdateKeys" that's supose to inform you from further updates
 [b]->[/b] "bikini top only*.png" is now in "access" folder, not longer in a subfolder
 [b]->[/b] The older file that is the entire shirts file with the mod Bikini top sprite is now in "Material for Community Updates" subfolder. It's still useful for comunity updates

[b]WARNINGS:
[/b] [b]- The warnings from previous versions will remain here, just in case you have an outdated version of the mod (which's pretty common). the warnings from those versions will have the version before its text.[/b]
 - This mod is 1.6.15 compatible mod. If Vanilla changes its logic on shirts indexing, it may malfunctioning.

 - [b]Updating this mod.[/b] Please, delete older versions before installing new ones.

 - [b]Version 1.0.0.[/b] If you have another mod which chages a shirt, this one may overlap it or be overlaped by it.
 - [b]Version 1.0.0.[/b] This mod is [b]1.6.15 compatible mod[/b]. If the original game add more shirts in further versions, this mod will potentially vanish with the new shirts.

[b]DETAILS[/b]
  This mod changes the sprites of the "bikini top" on Farmer when they are facing left and right [b]by replacing the original bikini top sprites from file with the farmer shirts from the original game file[/b]. Shout out for [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Tutorial:_Replacing_an_Image?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAR3eYHDL3RT2lBB8xtMf3OOS4AytsHVYxfV_4p4CzTtOTyLaeFvFSmUZy2o_aem_q7sSQe1YPmUAp_1ujLNu1Q]this article[/url] that taught me to do this fix. Now, the game will no longer overlap the entire shirts file, but, considering that it depends on the original file size and position to work, it may not work properly if further changes on Vanilla change this logic.
  The reason I made it is that the original game sprite perspective for this "bikini top" shirt is off: it appears [i]to be made for profile horizontal angle[/i], while the Stardew Valley sprites for the Farmer, when it's facing left or right, [i]have their body in 3/4 profile instead[/i].

[url=https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/a/AVvXsEiproJZavZNQBBuBGfIH2X4FqOy-g76SgqyVIjwYtkh4RDB8NeE5Jj483sC7-_PBr5cTvSdWj3Z9RT8oIKs1Upo5ZTjGiUWKX1seCIB_RZYZIzHi4Er3tNpzge71Q6mAhpsqSpEYDskABKicVKO9jZmWD1u404zcRLnIAwgRhxsE1Ca6HOuh6T0XIPKuR6f]Sprites Comparison[/url]
[url=https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjZya_fmWYfgEcGhXoq141Fjwh56acQj22wrsq9XD4mCh0AmpS5VTtHytHnbJT6nwH-9hnpYvhsrffOdhe-rr00gJcaTRutkj6uAu-cxzbovf0fJGGXs7vtKQJi5jv3qMRSmFWQxjF5FQ20GUnRN9txvLU4crFWLBrTGRPejsopDsANAT528Rt_kyHOvt69/s2279/Bikini%20Top%20Overhaul.png]Sketch Displaying The Original Game Mistake[/url]
  
[b] MOD DIRECTORY + COMMENT ABOUT EACH FILE (YOU MAY SKIP IT IF YOU'RE NOT A FELLOW MODDER)[/b]
"[i]Stardew Valley\Mods\Bikini Sprite Overhaul by Pandaboff\[/i]"
> assets\            [i]# the folder that contains the assets of the mod
[/i]= > info\              [i]# a folder that contains images explaining why the mod's been made[/i]
== > Bikini Top Overhaul.png                 [i]# a handmade sketch comparing vanilla's bikini top shirt with this mod's
[/i]== > Lídia bikini de lado antes.png       [i]# a print from the original game [b]without this mod[/b][/i]
== > Lídia bikini de lado depois.png     [i]# a print from the original game [i][b]with this mod[/b][/i][/i] 
= > Material for Community Updates\ [i]# a folder that contains material [b]for you[/b] in case you want enhance this mod or use its materials in other projects[/i]
== > shirts bikini side [date the current version has been made in DDMMYYYY].png
[i]# the shirts file from the game + the mod bikini top shirt from the mod. No longer in use for modding, but useful for maintenance purposes[/i]
= > bikini top only - Shirt ID [ingame bikini top id] - [date the current version has been made in DDMMYYYY].png
[i]# an image file with only the modded shirt. Since 1.0.1 version it actually replaces the bikini sprite from the original game with this image[/i] 
> content.json   [i]# the .json that coordenates how the mod executes[/i]
> manifest.json [i]# the standard manifest file of the mod[/i]

[b]INSTALATION INSTRUCTIONS[/b]
 - [b]If you have older versions of this mod.[/b] Delete previous versions of "Bikini Sprite Overhaul by Pandaboff" from your mod folder ("\Stardew Valley\Mods") before taking the next step.
 - Unzip this file in your mods folder: "\Stardew Valley\Mods"

[b]UNINSTALATION INSTRUCTIONS[/b]
 - Delete "Bikini Sprite Overhaul by Pandaboff" from your mod folder: "\Stardew Valley\Mods"
 - this mod only changes sprites.

==========================================

 This is my first mod ever. So, I hope you like it.
